csv_project_name: Conslt for Capital Improvement Plan Development
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Greensboro is soliciting Request for Proposals (RFP) from qualified firms to assist and advise the city in developing a detailed five year and 10-year summary capital improvement plan document. The project also requires opportunity for public review and comment of the CIP plan including opportunity to identify potential capital projects.

title: Consultant for Capital Improvement Plan Development
short_description: Consulting services to develop Greensboro's five- and ten-year capital improvement plan.
project_scope: Development of a detailed 5-year and 10-year capital improvement plan document for the City of Greensboro, including public review and comment opportunities and identification of potential capital projects.
services: Consulting services for capital improvement planning, including planning/master planning, architecture services, civil engineering, and construction/project management advisory.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a capital improvement planning and advisory assignment, not a defined structural or building project.
- No specific bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structure is identified.
- Scope is mainly planning/master planning and project management support, which is generally not a target area for sbp.
- No structural complexity, span, floor area, or innovative engineering component is described.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction project or budget is stated in the source. The assignment is for preparation of a capital improvement plan; therefore no realistic construction cost estimate can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee or budget information is provided in the source. As this is a general planning/advisory RFP without defined engineering scope, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms requested; specific reference or qualification requirements are not stated in the provided source excerpt.

notes: Pre-submittal meeting: 05/28/2026 11:00 AM EDT at City Hall, 102 E. South Street, Greensboro, GA 30642; attendance recommended. Solicitation documents available online. Although disciplines include architecture and civil engineering, the notice is for a citywide CIP planning document rather than a specific building or infrastructure project.
